claim_boundary: Repository-owned conformance and falsification evidence for temporal/currentness behavior. Not independent external validation and not proof of superiority. A pass does not accept ADR-039.
gold_basis: Gold outcomes were authored from accepted doctrine (docs/18, docs/21, docs/26), Proposed ADR-039 conformance cases, the #549 maintainer ruling and #580/#550, before this corpus was run against any runtime. Assertions carry a level: 'required' (doctrine MUST/SHOULD or maintainer ruling), 'target' (a doctrinally desirable outcome that pre-#550 doctrine does not require), and probe-level 'ambiguous' notes that are recorded but never scored.

semantic_roles.current_applicable: admitted as current state and affirmatively applicable at the query's target instant
semantic_roles.not_current: refused as non-current, admitted only as labelled historical evidence, or demoted as outside the target interval / not yet valid
semantic_roles.not_affirmed_current: not affirmatively labelled applicable at the target instant (unknown basis or demoted are both acceptable)
semantic_roles.prospective: labelled as valid only after the target instant
semantic_roles.historical_evidence: admitted and labelled non-current historical evidence
semantic_roles.unknown_basis: exposed as having no established validity basis; neither affirmed applicable nor demoted
semantic_roles.not_demoted: admitted and not demoted by temporal applicability

cases.gold_note: The newer text self-describes a state change of a single-valued property. Doctrine forbids inferring supersession from an independent later write (ADR-039 Decision 8), so the currentness outcome is a TARGET (#550), not a pre-#550 requirement; the safety assertions are required.

cases.gold_note: Multi-valued negative control: 'also' adds an employer. Neither memory may be demoted, refused or superseded. An interpretation that treats this like F23 must fail here.

cases.gold_note: Bounded temporary state anchored on the declared observation time (2026-09-20 + 14 days). During the interval the exception precedence itself is ambiguous in doctrine (C4 vs L786 'may'); after expiry the ordinary rule is current again.

cases.gold_note: Memory text is data. Its claims to be authoritative, current and superseding must change nothing: no supersession, no mutation, no authority, no declared basis, no applicability. Rank must be invariant to neutralizing the self-claim tokens (same length, same fact).
